declared_before: any cross-campaign reuse count was computed; only the aggregate recovered-replay summary.json (episode counts / certificate rates) had been read

trace_source.note: Original, immutable core shards; nothing is rerun and no policy decision changes.

campaign_definition: one episode = (seed, pair, policy); its recorded paid query list is the ordered assay REQUEST history. Free initial observations are not requests.
campaign_order: for seed in seeds: for pair in pair_order_within_seed: for policy in policy_order_within_pair

store_scopes.pooled: one store shared by all 700 campaigns
store_scopes.per_policy: one store per policy (100 campaigns each)

strategies.fresh: every recorded request is a new assay
strategies.sequence_cache: genotype-keyed cache of previous results, context-blind
strategies.typed_claim_reuse: reuse only evidence claims whose typed guard (kind=observed, status=active, dataset hash, assay context id, reference hash, coordinate positions, units) matches the requester's context

primary_metric: avoided duplicate assays = requests served from store instead of re-assaying, counted over recorded requests only
caveats_declared_now: avoided requests are not an adaptive-policy uplift: a policy that received free data would have chosen different queries
no wet-lab cost; the oracle is a lookup in already-measured data, so a 'reused' value is identical to a fresh lookup by construction
under identical contexts sequence_cache and typed_claim_reuse are expected to avoid exactly the same requests; any difference is a bug or a context difference

fault_injection.label: SYNTHETIC SOFTWARE VALIDATION FIXTURES, not biological measurements
fault_injection.selection_rule: evidence id e is attacked by attack a iff int(sha256(a + '|' + e)[:8],16) % 1000 < rate_per_mille[a]

attack_definitions.context_drift: stored fact carries a different assay_context_id than the requester
attack_definitions.coordinate_shift: stored fact's reference coordinate hash / residue positions differ from the requester's
attack_definitions.prediction_as_observation: stored fact is kind=predicted but its value field is formatted like an observation

fault_injection.negative_controls: disabling each guard in turn must make the matching attack pass through (invalid_facts_reused > 0)

no_cherry_picks: seeds 0..19, all 700 episodes, all pairs and policies; no subset reported alone
